title: CIVA: Critic-Induced Value-Subspace Attacks on Visual World-Model Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.21114v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual world-model agents such as DreamerV3 act through a recurrent latent state rather than a single observation, which weakens frame-wise observation attacks and makes their perturbations vary sharply over time under a strict per-frame perturbation constraint. We study white-box, causal, online attacks on such agents and propose Critic-Induced Value-Subspace Attacks (\textbf{CIVA}). Our key observation is that, along a rollout, critic-guided perturbations concentrate in a low-dimensional subspace induced by the victim's own critic. Based on this observation, CIVA first probes the frozen victim offline with critic-guided PGD and extracts a low-rank value-subspace by SVD. At test time, it optimizes only the subspace coefficients, smooths them with an exponential moving average (EMA), and maps them back to pixels. This design attacks value-sensitive recurrent dynamics while keeping the online optimization cheap and temporally coherent.

translated_title: CIVA：针对视觉世界模型代理的评论家诱导价值子空间攻击
translated_abstract: 视觉世界模型代理（如DreamerV3）通过循环潜在状态而非单一观察来行动，这削弱了逐帧观察攻击，并在严格的每帧扰动约束下使其扰动随时间急剧变化。我们研究了对此类代理的白盒、因果、在线攻击，并提出了评论家诱导价值子空间攻击（CIVA）。我们的关键观察是，在一次展开中，评论家引导的扰动集中在由受害者自身评论家诱导的低维子空间中。基于此观察，CIVA首先使用评论家引导的PGD离线探测冻结的受害者，并通过SVD提取低秩价值子空间。在测试时，它仅优化子空间系数，用指数移动平均（EMA）平滑这些系数，并将其映射回像素。这种设计攻击价值敏感的循环动态，同时保持在线优化廉价且时间上连贯。
tldr: 本文提出CIVA攻击方法，通过识别并利用评论家诱导的低维价值子空间，实现对视觉世界模型代理的高效、时间连贯的白盒在线攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CIVA, an attack method that exploits critic-induced low-dimensional value subspaces to achieve efficient and temporally coherent white-box online attacks on visual world-model agents.
